original_test_intent: Run 250 WAT DC reboot cycles and verify OS ping/reachability plus overall system health after each cycle.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Execute the source WAT command with 250 cycles and `-s BMC_P DC OS OS_I BMC_I`.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: OS ping and cycle health succeed; Machine Time is 1800 minutes.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; required signed WAT flag-to-OS-Ping mapping and treated Machine Time among the ambiguities.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer supplies WAT package/semantics, power plan and endpoints; existing WAT cycle execution is then automated.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 250 WAT DC cycles with the exact source scenario tokens; 1800-minute Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Signed OS-Ping mapping, DC semantics, boot-ready/ping parameters, baselines, secret path, failure policy and override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Changed cycle count or ping definition is a project difference.

original_method: Exact WAT command and token order are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved WAT package only after its version-specific manual proves the scenario maps to OS ping and DC cycling.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: WAT-supported platform and BMC power path.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable WAT manual or approved vendor SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: No replacement; adds immutable per-attempt evidence and secret handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Package, semantics, ping source/target and failure rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Private token meaning and power behavior cannot be guessed.

missing_inputs: WAT package/hash and signed OS-Ping mapping
Ping endpoint/allowance and DC readiness semantics
safety_boundaries: No guessed flags, warm/AC substitution or hidden retry
no_automatic_retry: Failed attempts remain in the ledger; extra attempts require approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Cycle engineer interprets WAT output and formal status.
